title: map view: a deployment-wide default map style (setting + runtime-config + Console CSP), so an intranet deployment can replace demotiles.maplibre.org
body:
carries item 2 of #25889; #25889 keeps item 1 (the translated failure notice and the fall-back to the marker list, dispatched by `domain:ui` seat 2, #25995)

Filing gate **④ a coordination node split from a queued card**: the half of #25889 that cannot land in `ui/`. Split by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (session `session_01SMps7wq7rBTk53e8KTSEup`) at the pre-dispatch premise check. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` on purpose: the landing spans more than one lane, and its domain is triage's call.

## Business reason

#25889: every deployment without public internet, or whose policy forbids a third-party tile host, gets a grey map canvas. The map renderer's only style source besides a per-view `mapStyle` is a hard-coded `https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json`. Without a deployment-wide default, an administrator must edit every map view of every app (including AI-built ones) to get a working map.

## Readings (`origin/main` `05f7758f05`, 2026-10-26T08:25Z)

- Per-view authoring already exists: `ObjectMap.tsx` reads `schema.mapStyle || schema.map?.style`; spec `ui/component.zod.ts` (`mapStyle`) and `ui/view.zod.ts` (`ListMapConfigSchema.style`). No deployment-level source exists.
- `ui/packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx` `DEFAULT_MAP_STYLE` is the demotiles URL, used as the fallback.
- No env/vite/runtime-config read in `plugin-map`; `plugin-map` does not depend on `app-shell`, so it cannot call `getRuntimeConfig()` without a new seam (context or console-injected prop).
- `GET /api/v1/runtime/config` (`packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-plugin.ts`) has a closed payload with no map key; branding (`workspace_name` → `branding.productName`, env fallback) is the precedent for a Setup value served there.
- The Console CSP (`packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`) allow-lists the demotiles origin in `connect-src`, computed once at boot; `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC` is the only extension. A style host saved in Setup would stay blocked by the CSP unless the operator also sets that env, or the CSP learns the setting.

## Open questions for triage (and the maintainer if it is a decision)

1. Home of the value: a Setup setting served via runtime-config (the card's ask) or an env var read by `RuntimeConfigPlugin`.
2. The runtime-config door is anonymous, so the style URL becomes public; and the CSP must follow the value. Both are a security-boundary choice.
3. New key ⇒ per #25889's triage comment, the key card lands first and the `ui/` reader follows.

## Reader who acts

Triage routes it (likely `domain:server` for runtime-config + CSP + settings manifest, with a `domain:ui` sub-card for the renderer seam).

## Dedupe

REST list of the 600 newest objectstack issues (open and closed, #25385–#25995) grepped locally for `map style|demotiles|tile host|mapstyle`: 2 hits — #25889 (the parent) and #25569 (closed, nonce-based Console CSP; adds no map setting). Control: the same corpus finds `compareTo` in 2 issues, so the instrument reaches bodies.
